title: Currency Hilton Young Commission
definition: The Royal Commission on Indian Currency and Finance (1926), chaired by Edward Hilton Young, was a pivotal body tasked with investigating the Indian currency system and recommending the establishment of a central bank to stabilize the economy.
importanceInUpsc: It is the foundational bedrock for the evolution of India's monetary policy, the establishment of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), and the transition from the Gold Exchange Standard to a managed currency system.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Currency Hilton Young Commission.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Gold Standard vs. Gold Exchange Standard
Evolution of Banking in British India
